query:
select input_tokens_total-claude_cache_read_input_tokens as q,
        output_tokens as o from rounds where provider='claude'
        and input_tokens_total>0 and output_tokens>0
        and claude_cache_read_input_tokens>=.9*input_tokens_total
        and claude_cache_read_input_tokens between 131072 and 393216
        and input_tokens_total-claude_cache_read_input_tokens between 1 and 10240
        order by round_pk
interpretation: Ratio of aggregate warm-cohort new-input to output tokens; not mean per-request ratios.
prefill_proxy: Use existing 1024-new-token per-token throughput at 262144 resident prefix; actual input-length distribution not replayed.
model_transfer: Same workload token ratio for all four architectures; tokenizer/verbosity/quality differences not modeled.
